name: Riot Client (Valorant, League of Legends, TFT)
summary: Not possible on any Linux: Riot Vanguard is a Windows-only kernel anti-cheat - Valorant and League of Legends cannot run on Lindos.
notes:
Valorant and (since 2024) League of Legends / Teamfight Tactics require Riot Vanguard, a kernel-level anti-cheat driver that only exists for Windows and must be running before the game starts. Wine and Proton cannot load Windows kernel drivers, and Riot deliberately blocks every Linux/Wine environment - there is no workaround, no 'special Wine', no VM trick that Riot allows (VMs are detected and banned). Anyone claiming otherwise is either out of date (pre-Vanguard League ran through Lutris until early 2024) or asking you to install something you should not.
The Riot Client installer itself (Install VALORANT.exe / live.na.exe) may open under Wine, but it will stop at 'Vanguard not installed' or fail during the download - do not bother.
What you can do on Lindos: play the many other competitive titles that do run (Counter-Strike 2 and Dota 2 native; Apex is not; Overwatch 2, Marvel Rivals, Warframe, Helldivers 2 through Proton - see docs/COMPATIBILITY.md and areweanticheatyet.com), or keep a Windows install / cloud gaming (GeForce NOW streams League of Legends; Valorant is not offered there) for Riot titles.

alternatives.name: Not possible
alternatives.how: Vanguard kernel anti-cheat is Windows-only; Valorant / League of Legends / TFT cannot run on Lindos or any Linux (see areweanticheatyet.com)
